subject: Insurance
title: Africa's Mobile Insurance Revolution
description: A short lesson to help you apply Africa's Mobile Insurance Revolution.

hook.text: In Kenya, you can buy life insurance via text message.

buildup.text: Traditional insurance needs offices, agents, and paperwork. Mobile insurance needs only a phone and a mobile wallet.

discovery.text: Companies like BIMA sell micro-policies to millions across Africa. Premiums are deducted daily from mobile credit.

twist.text: Trust is the biggest barrier. Many Africans view insurance as a scam because past providers didn't pay claims reliably.

climax.text: Mobile insurance could bring coverage to 2 billion uninsured people.

punchline.text: Buy insurance by text. Mobile money brought coverage to millions in Africa.

quiz.question: What enabled insurance access in Kenya?
